column2: Expelled from green England by the Norman invaders centuries ago, today we have accomplished our fathers' dreams: England is ours once more! §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with forming the HBE.
Proclaim Beornia the Holy Britannian Empire

Instead of dreaming of reconquering the lands we left centuries ago, we must focus on our new sphere of interest - Ameriga. Let's forge an Empire yet unseen! §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with retaking England.

After pushing the Vikings and the Normans out of Britain we must now make amends with our Scottish brothers and finish the job by conquering Ireland, only then Great Britain shall be free from potential invaders.

If we are to retake England giving up on our British ambitions to secure an alliance with the Scandinavians might be on our best interests. §R\nNote: if your take this decision and Scandi accepts you will be forever blocked from forming the UK.
What the hell even is a "Londres"? We must overturn this utter woke non-sense and go back to proper Anglo-Saxon naming conventions such as "Cummings".

London has long been transformed into an Anglois stronghold by the Norman scum which sadly means we need to look for a new capital. London has been historically the capital of England but during the reign of Alfred the Great Winchester acted as one of his two capitals alongside London.
Now that we regained our rightful islands we shall change their name back to their original one.
Finally, we have taken back from the barbarian Westerners our imperial capital of Cusco! Let us establish their once more the capital of the glorious Inca realm.
We have control of all of Ameriga, we can form the Federation!
We can now fully guarantee the rights of the Afro Amerigans.
Now that we are the Federation, our claims extend into the Amazon!
Beornia has been a thorn in our side, but no longer, we can now integrate the nation into our own.
It is our destiny to unify all of Ameriga under the Federation, and we have set ourselves up to achieve this dream.
We have freed the Granadans from their oppression, we can now accept them into our Federation.
We have freed the Caribeans from their oppression, we can now accept them into our nation.

There are those that defend the idea of a Republic where all citizens are equal with no blood prerogatives, however, there's a growing movement within congress that argues that a Monarchy would help legitimize our state in the minds of European nations.

The Conquest of Scotland is recent and we have a hard time proving to the locals that we are their rightful brethren. But with our dominance in Europe and the Anglois dream pushing in the Lowlands and Highlands it might be possible to eventually settle the situation in Scotland.

Calais and the surrounding plains of Picardie were important places during the Hundred Years War. Sadly this territory was lost with Calais being surrendered to the Burgundian king during the Anglo-French wars of Religion. But with our troops having recaptured the closest land to England we could make the International Concert recognize our claim!
The French claim on the Free County of Burgundy is solid. Though we had to project our power through force, we can claim the ethernal right to these lands.
The little Provencal state is no more. Our armies have taken control of what was the biggest thorn on our borders. With the Valois gone, the Anglois state prevails!

The Rhine River has been the official border of the Kingdom of Burgundy since the conquests of Charles the Bold of 1483, even if it would take time to integrate the various duchies and cities in the Burgundian state. While they never enjoyed the same relation the Dutch had with the Valois the Rhineland was not a rebellious area, that is until the German revolution. Ever since the contract between Burgundy and the Rhenish seemed to have been broken. Eventually with efficient policies of integration this trust can be rebuild as to secure the loyalty of the Rhineland to Anvers.
For centuries the Platagenets neglected the lands of France. With the French duchies now under our control, we can claim the crown as a way to get letimaticy in our new acquired territories.

Uniting Iberia was one of the ambitions of medieval monarchs of the Iberian peninsula. Sancho III of Navarre and Alfonso VII of Leon and Castile both took the title Imperator Totius Hispaniae, meaning 'Emperor of all Hispania' centuries before. But with the rise of the Dual Monarchy in the East it was too dangerous for Castille to extend its territories and instead of the planned union with Aragon, the Kingdom of Spain was created by merging the crowns of Castille and Portugal. With our control of the former Aragonese lands of Catalunya we can proclaim the Iberian Union. §R\nMutually exclusive with the Hispanic Commonwealth.

Liberalisation has changed our society and the old relationship between peninsulares and criollos, based on inequality and submission to the metropolis, can no longer stand. It is time to move on to a new era of brotherhood between the Hispanic peoples and create a Commonwealth bringing together in harmony the metropolis and its erstwhile colonies. Spain and Colombia, bonded by blood and fire, from the conquest of the Indies to the bloody revolutionary warfare, enter a new age of reconciliation and equality. §R\nMutually exclusive with the Hispanic Commonwealth.

The Kingdom of Croatia entered a personal union with Hungary in the chaotic years that ensued the extinguishing of the Trpimirovic dynasty, a situation that persisted until the Ottoman conquest of Hungary. The Croatian throne has remained vacant ever since, with the Croatian revolutionaries reneging on their medieval heritage to instead found the Kingdom of Illyria - making patent their pan-Slavic ambitions beyond the old borders of Croatia. The recovery of the Holy Crown of St Stephen has legitimised the new Hungarian Kingdom as the successor to the ï¿½rpï¿½d Dynasty, and as such, to its possessions both in Hungary and in Croatia. The conquest of Croatia will reestablish the position of the Magyar as one of the prominent peoples in Europe as well as give us much-needed access to the Mediterranean Sea along the Dalmatian coast.

The Croatians had enjoyed a great deal of autonomy under the personal union with Hungary in the Middle Ages. Yet Croats and Magyars became separated in the aftermath of the Ottoman conquest, divided in Bohemian, Venetian and Turkish spheres of influence, and after liberation the upsurge in Magyar ethno-nationalism poisoned the relationship between the erstwhile brother peoples. The $YEAR$ Croatian-Hungarian Kiegyezï¿½s - Compromise - will rectify the current situation and acknowledge the long-standing tradition of self-government of Croatia within Hungary while recognising the status of Croatians as full citizens of our state and the Croatian language as co-official with Magyar.

The Vlachs were left out during the drafting of the Transylvanian constitution and, indeed, they are not recognised as one of the three nations that constitute the federal Principality - the Magyars, the Szekely and the Saxons. Nevertheless the Vlachs are the largest minority in Transylvania, far outnumbering the Saxons and being close in numbers to the Magyars, making the current situation of political disenfranchisement and cultural repression untenable in the long run. If Transylvania is to survive as an independent polity, we must amend the constitution to recognise the Vlach nation and their status as equals to any other citizen of the Principality.

The reconquest of the old borders of the medieval Kingdom of Croatia brought millions of slavic subjects under our rule - yet the conquest was incomplete, for the Serb people are now split by the Hungarian frontier. Irredentism runs high among the Serbs, who long not only for re-unification with their brothers in Bosnia and the Krajina but also dream of a Yugoslav state encompassing Croats and Bosniaks as well. In recent years increasingly effective agitation by Serb agents in Bosnia and Dalmatia has thwarted Hungarian attempts to pacify the countryside and establish proper administration of the area, and is now starting to spread northwards towards Slavonia and the Temeskï¿½z, thus endangering the heart of Hungary itself. The only solution is to unite the South Slavs on our own terms - annexing the remaning Serbian territory outside our realm and re-organising it as dependent territories of the Magyar state.

The Commonwealth has experienced a severe decay in the last century. Problems with the Sejm, foreign intervention and weakness of the government led to a near break-up of the Union. But now we have reasserted our status in the European Concert and rid ourselves from foreign intervention, we can centralize the state in Warsaw and retake our place in Eastern Europe!

The Ruthenians constitute the most important ethnic group in the Commonwealth behind the Polish. Over the centuries, we have tried to integrate in our fabric, granting some of their nobles rights in the Sejm, encouraging the Uniate Church in spreading catholiscism. Now a new proposition has emerged to transform our state into a Polish-Lithuanian-Ruthenian Commonwealth but it needs the approval of the Ruthenian leaders

The Livonians and Estonian people never truly enjoyed independence, being contested between the Commonwealth and Scandinavia. But in contrary to the Scandinavians, we have a tradition of accepting the local cultures and integrate in our state! Long live the Polish rule of Livonia!

For centuries now, the crown of Aragon has been a dominant power on the Italian peninsula. We are now strong enough to strengthen our rule over Italy and proclaim the Dual Kingdom of Aragon and Italy! But let us beware, the other European Great Powers might not take the news kindly...

The Provencal are the closest cultural kin to the Catalans, with both cultures sharing a close origin and both languages being mutually intelligible. Over the centuries our peoples have remained mostly separate, with most of the ProvenÃ§al speaking territory falling to the Anglois Monarchy after the 1532 Languedoc War. However, with our increased power after the end of North Italian autonomy and North Italian intergration, we are finally in a position of sufficient strength to end the ProvenÃ§al oppression once and for all and embrace them into our realm.
We now have the ability to dissolve the illusion of a free Papal State government, and directly control its territory.
We now have the ability to dissolve the illusion of a free Ferraran government, and directly control its territory.

Since the repression of the independence movements, our Republic has seen many changes. Our government is now more democratic and the Greek have accepted our rule. It is now time to fully integrate them into our republic!
We have effectively controlled the region of Pomerania since the Peace of Westphalia. With the rise of nationalism it is critical that we make sure our subjects feel as a part of our great nation.

Despite all their attempts, the Bohemians could not stop our ambition. We control much of Northern Germany and it is our duty to help the Elbian people and accept them into our Union. Let us proclaim them brothers of the Scandinavians and use them to strenghten our state! §R\nMutually exclusive with "Claim Ireland".
With Ireland now under our total control we must consolidate our administration in the island in order to solidify our rule. §R\nMutually exclusive with "Nordtyskland".
Now that we control Pomerania, Prussia, Livland, Lithuania and Pskov we can affirm our place as the Masters of the Baltic Sea, our very own Viking Mare Nostrum.

Note: §RMutually exclusive with "Maintain Constantinople as the Imperial Capital". §GWill allow you to take decisions to accept the Misri, Caucasian Christian, Bedouin, and Azerbaijani. §!\nAnkara is the heartland of the Turkic people of Anatolia, and a more defensible location away from European enemies. Moving our capital here will allow us to consolidate our eastern part of the empire.
Maintain Constantinople as the Imperial Capital

Note: §RMutually exclusive with "Move the Capital to Ankara". §GWill allow you to take decisions to accept the Greek, Albanian, Serb and Croat cultures and will let you increase the life rating of your Balkan possessions. §!\nAs the heart of the Ottoman Empire for centuries, Constantinople stands as a symbol of imperial grandeur, straddling Europe and Asia. While some modernizers argue for relocating the capital to Ankara—a more defensible and central location—abandoning Constantinople would mean turning our backs on centuries of history, prestige, and economic strength. By reaffirming Constantinople as our capital, we preserve our connection to the legacy of the Sultans, maintain control over the vital Bosporus trade routes, and demonstrate our commitment to defending our core lands against foreign encroachment.

With the diverse peoples of the Ottoman Empire living under the Sultan's rule, the Greek population has long been a vital part of our administration, commerce, and intellectual life. By formally recognizing Greek as an accepted culture, we can strengthen loyalty in the region, improve administrative efficiency, and foster greater unity within the empire. This decision will not only appease the Greek populace but also harness their economic and political potential for the benefit of the state.

The Albanian people have long served as loyal soldiers and administrators within the Ottoman Empire, with many rising to high ranks in the Janissary corps and provincial governance. By formally recognizing Albanian as an accepted culture, we can secure the allegiance of these fierce warriors, strengthen our hold over the western Balkans, and undermine separatist sentiments. This decision will reward their loyalty, encourage further service to the state, and ensure the stability of our European frontiers.

The Serbian population has been a source of both rebellion and reluctant loyalty within our European provinces. By formally recognizing Serbian as an accepted culture, we may pacify nationalist unrest, harness their agricultural and trade networks, and deny foreign powers a tool to undermine Ottoman unity. This gesture—combined with measured reforms—could transform the Serbs from subjects to stakeholders in the Empire’s survival.
Incorporate Illyrian Nobility into the Imperial Framework

Though the Illyrians have long been under the sway of the Magyars, their lands remain a strategic buffer between Ottoman Europe and Catholic Christendom. By extending formal recognition to Croatian culture—particularly through alliances with influential Bosnian Croat clans and defectors from the Military Frontier—we may weaken Austrian influence, secure our northwestern border, and gain access to skilled cavalrymen and administrators. Let us offer privileges to those who serve, rather than lose them to foreign crowns.
From the vineyards of Thessaly to the workshops of Bosnia, let the Sultan’s peace be measured not in garrisons but in schoolhouses and railroads.
Incorporate Egyptian into the Imperial Framework

Though Egypt remains firmly under the direct control of the Sublime Porte, its people have long been treated as distant subjects rather than core constituents of the Empire. By formally recognizing Egyptian culture as an integral part of the Ottoman realm, we can strengthen administrative efficiency, secure the loyalty of the Nile Valley, and harness Egypt's vast resources for the benefit of the entire state. This decision will integrate Egyptian soldiers, bureaucrats, and merchants into the imperial system while maintaining Istanbul's firm governance over the region.

From the dunes of Najd to the oases of Libya, the Bedouin tribes have served as both the scourge and the sentinels of Ottoman authority in Arabia. Rather than wasting men and gold to subdue these desert warriors, we shall embrace them as partners of the state—granting their chiefs imperial titles, regulating their camel postal networks, and harnessing their unmatched knowledge of the desert frontiers. In exchange for autonomy under the Sultan's banner, they shall police the Hajj routes and keep the Wahhabis at bay.
Integrate the Armenian Millet as an Imperial Pillar

For centuries, the Armenian people have served as the Empire’s merchants, bankers, and diplomats—yet their loyalty remains precarious under foreign interference. By formally elevating Armenian culture to accepted status, we reward their historic service, undermine Russian and British subversion, and transform a vulnerable minority into a bulwark of Ottoman modernity. Let the workshops of Constantinople and the farms of Anatolia flourish under this new compact.
Unify the Turkic and Maghrebi Realms

From the Caspian shores to the Atlas Mountains, our Empire shelters kindred peoples who share the faith and traditions of the Sublime State. By formally embracing the Azerbaijani Turks as linguistic brethren and the Maghrebi Arabs as strategic partners, we may forge a pan-Islamic axis against European encroachment—binding Baku's oil and Algiers' corsairs to Istanbul's glory.

The Holy Roman Empire could have been the greatest power of the continent if it had been united. The previous emperor tried to centralize the various principalities during the Revolution but the Great German War forced him to withdraw its claims. But now we are strong enough to try the adventure once more and this time, maybe establish a Reich that will last a Thousand Years! §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with forming Elbians.
Form the Confederation at the Elbe

The dream of reunifying the German lands under our dominion is now forfeit. The revolutions and the rise of German nationalism have provoked an immense opposition to the unified Reich. However we hold special ties with the Elbian people and if we could bring the North German lands under our protection we could annex the princes of the north and govern the Elbians as equals to the Bohemians. §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with forming the HRE.
Although Prussia was never part of our sphere of influence, the lands we have conquered are still predominently inhabited by Germans. We can thus add them to our Realm.

Our dominant position over the south and central German states is now firmly established. While it will still take time to unify all the Germans, today we can at last form a proper German kingdom - a stepping-stone to greater things!

Our domination of the German areas is now beyond contest - for the first time in a millennia, the German people are united under a flag, ours! Let us proclaim the Greater German state, and take our rightful place as leaders of Europe!
Despite our efforts, the princes of the Empire did not accept our claim. We defeated them and we can rightfully be recognized Kaiser by the Germans! Ein Reich, Ein Deustchland!
With our state controlling most of the Rhine region we have gained the support of the locals! Fur die Vaterland!
Proclaim the Tsardom of all Russias

Our domination over the Eastern Slavs is complete, and the time has come to declare a single states of all the Russians. The Great Bear has finally risen, and now Europe shall fear us! §G\nYou will unlock new decisions to get more cores and accepted cultures.

The Tsardom has competed with the Tatars for centuries and the areas along the Don and the Volga rivers have changed hands regularly. The current balance of power makes us a possible target of the Scandinavians through their puppet of Novgorod but should we rise again we could easily claim the Steppes as ours!

Now that we've united the Russian people, there is some debate about how to handle the various states on our western border. We could focus on liberating the Ruthenian people to our west. Since they are so culturally similar to us, it would be easier to incorporate them into our state. §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with the other Ambition decisions. §G\nYou will be able to accept the Ruthenian culture.

We could focus on expanding our access to the Black Sea by taking advantage of the declining steppe khanates. §R\nNote: mutually exclusive with the other Ambition decisions. §G\nYou will be able to accept the Tatar and the Caucasian Christians cultures.
As our (somewhat) close cultural kin, the Ruthenians certainly deserve full political rights within our empire.

Though the Finnish, Estonian, and Latvian lands have only recently come under the Tsar’s rule, their people are not so different from our own. By offering them full integration into the empire—with rights, duties, and opportunities equal to those of ethnic Russians—we may turn potential resistance into loyalty and strengthen the realm for generations to come.
Embrace the peoples of the Caucasus and the steppes

The Tatars, Georgians, and Armenians have long been neighbors to Russia—some as rivals, others as reluctant subjects. Now, as our empire grows, we must decide: shall we rule them as conquerors, or welcome them as brothers? By recognizing their nobility, their faith, and their worth, we may bind them to the Tsar's cause and turn contested lands into pillars of the realm.

In the early 18th century, Mikhail the Great made great efforts to modernize and strengthen Muscovy. We should honor and continue his efforts by building a great city on the Baltic and making it our capital. Nyenschantz isn't ice-free all year, but it's easily defensible and already somewhat populated. Furthermore, it would allow our a greater degree of control over our new Baltic subjects, which could very well make integrating them easier.

Rostov is located at the mouth of the Don River and has easy access to the Black Sea. If we are to focus on expanding southwards, it would make an excellent capital, giving us easy access to the entire Mediterranean and opening up many opportunities for trade, diplomacy, and expansion. We would also be able to exert greater control over recently incorporated steppe peoples, which could very well make integrating them easier.
The Korean rebellion is finally crushed and our peaceful rule over the peninsula may continue.
The Man in the High Castle

The Chinese colonists founded the Dong Guo federation long time ago and since then it has developed into a full-fledged country. But somehow they stand in way of establishing total control over the Pacific.
Japan now controls Formosa, and our modern administration will get rid of Gaijin names and change the island accordingly.

However the occupation is harsh and expensive with the Panjabis more numerous that all the Afghan tribes... But if we can take all of Punjab, maybe a new path could emerge for the Sadozai, and maybe they could enter the Indian game...

Note: §RMutually exclusive with forming Arabia. §GWill allow you to eventually accept Bulgarian and Greek after conquering some lands. §!\nConstantinople slumbers, a captive to the antiquated traditions and corrupt inefficiencies that have brought the Ottoman state to the brink of collapse. While they recede, we have ascended—forging a modern government, a disciplined army, and a nation poised at the forefront of progress. The Turkish yoke is broken, but our ambition cannot be contained to the Nile alone. The entire Eastern world seeks a new leader, a power capable of standing as an equal among the European giants. Let us formally cast aside the vestiges of Ottoman suzerainty and proclaim ourselves the true heirs to the legacy of Eastern Empire, shifting the center of gravity from the Bosphorus to the banks of the Nile.

The vast and fertile lands along the Upper Nile, rich in ivory and potential slaves, have long been a source of wealth for the petty kingdoms and tribes that inhabit them. This disunity is their weakness and our opportunity. By right of geography and power, the destiny of the Sudan is inextricably linked to ours. We shall dispatch our armies south to bring order from chaos, to impose a single, firm hand upon the region, and to channel its riches north to the treasury in Cairo. The Nile is our artery
column3: it is only natural that we command its entire length.

column2: Our acquisitions along the Somali coast and the arid interior represent a strategic foothold of immense value, guarding the entrance to the Red Sea and the trade routes beyond. However, these territories currently exist as little more than flagged dots on a map, governed by ad-hoc military authority and tenuous agreements with local clans. To secure our long-term interests and move from mere occupation to profitable governance, we must implement a formal administrative structure. This will involve the deployment of civilian officials, the establishment of a basic legal framework for trade and land rights, and the creation of a logistical network to connect our scattered ports and garrisons. Only through such organized administration can we hope to quell internecine conflict, foster economic activity, and truly lay claim to this pivotal corner of the continent.

For centuries, the Bulgarian people have suffered under the Ottoman yoke, their national spirit suppressed, their aspirations for freedom met with brutal force. Yet, in their struggle, we see a reflection of our own. They are a people of proud warriors and diligent farmers, whose desire for self-determination aligns with our own project of building a new, modern state that transcends the old Ottoman order. As the 'Sick Man' weakens, a wave of Bulgarian intellectuals, officers, and craftsmen look south for a patron and a new home. Let us extend our hand. By offering them sanctuary, citizenship, and a stake in our empire, we will gain a fiercely loyal new demographic, skilled in European arts of war and industry, and strike a profound ideological blow against Constantinople. We will prove that our state is the true heir to the future, built not on the decadence of the past, but on the alliance of all those who have thrown off the Ottoman chains.

From the halls of the Library of Alexandria to the wisdom of the Ptolemies, the Hellenic spirit has been intertwined with the destiny of Egypt since antiquity. Now, as the Greek people rise in valiant struggle against their Ottoman oppressors, they look not only to their past, but to a future they might help build. We see in them not mere refugees, but the heirs of a glorious tradition—master sailors, erudite scholars, and shrewd merchants. Let us extend a formal invitation to the Hellenic world: come to Egypt, not as guests, but as partners. In revitalizing our navy, our academies, and our commerce, you will find a homeland that venerates your heritage as a cornerstone of its own new, composite identity. Together, we can forge a power that draws from the deepest wells of Mediterranean civilization, leaving the ossified Ottoman Empire as a relic of a bygone age.

Note: §RMutually exclusive with forming Persia. §GWill allow you to get cores in Sicily and southern Iberia after conquering them. §!\nFor centuries, the Arab people have been divided, their lands fractured under the rule of foreign empires and squabbling dynasties. The flame of a shared identity—forged by language, history, and faith—has been kept alive in the hearts of the people. Now, that flame can become a beacon. From the Atlantic Ocean to the Arabian Gulf, a single voice calls for unity. It is time to cast aside the artificial borders drawn by outsiders and reclaim our destiny. Let us unite the Arab lands under one banner, one nation, and one people. We shall proclaim a new state, not as a mere kingdom, but as a union of all Arabs—a power to stand as a peer among the great empires of the world and herald a modern Nahda (Renaissance) for our civilization.

The flame of a shared identity—forged by language, history, and faith—has been kept alive in the hearts of the people. Now, that flame can become a beacon. From the Atlantic Ocean to the Arabian Gulf, a single voice calls for unity. It is time to cast aside the artificial borders drawn by outsiders and reclaim our destiny. Let us unite the Arab lands under one banner, one nation, and one people. We shall proclaim a new state, not as a mere kingdom, but as a union of all Arabs—a power to stand as a peer among the great empires of the world and herald a modern Nahda (Renaissance) for our civilization.

The memory of Al-Andalus is a ghost that haunts the pillars of Hercules. For centuries, the call to prayer echoed from the minarets of Cordoba and Granada, and the light of knowledge flourished while Europe slumbered in darkness. The Reconquista was not merely a military defeat
column3: it was a wound upon the soul of the Arab world, a forced exile from a land that we shaped for seven hundred years. That exile ends now. Our armies stand once more on the soil of our ancestors. The great mosques, now desecrated into cathedrals, bear witness to our return. This is not a mere conquest
column4: it is a rectification of history. We shall tear down the walls of ignorance that have been built and re-establish the administration of a civilized, modern Caliphate over its westernmost province. Al-Andalus will be Arab once more.

column2: The foothold we have secured in Al-Andalus is but the beginning. The Umayyad Caliphs of old did not limit their vision to the south
column3: their influence stretched into the very heart of the Iberian peninsula. The cities of Toledo, Madrid, and Barcelona once paid tribute to and were enriched by Islamic civilization. The ghosts of the Banu Qasi and the Taifa kings demand we finish what was started. Our presence here is no longer a reclamation of a lost province, but the foundation of a new Western Caliphate, a peer and partner to the seat of the Caliphate in the East. Let our administration spread north, bringing order and enlightenment to these lands once more. We shall not merely hold a coastline

column2: Sicily was once the jewel of the Mediterranean, a vibrant Emirate where Arab, Byzantine, and Norman cultures fused to create a beacon of progress. Its ports were gateways, its scholars were legendary, and its fields were enriched by our irrigation. For centuries, it has languished under foreign neglect, its potential squandered. But the memory of that golden age has not faded. With the Straits of Gibraltar secured and our fleet commanding the sea, the path to Palermo is open. Let us restore the administrative brilliance of the old Emirate, turning this fertile island into the central hub of our Mediterranean trade and a bastion of our power. From here, we can project our influence to the very shores of Italy and North Africa, weaving them back into the commercial and cultural web they were always meant to be a part of.
The age of the steppe warriors is over. However, if we could unite the khanates of the European steppe, it would be a fitting tribute to their legacy, and a counter to growing Russian nationalism.

In order to survive as as a nation-state, we Tatars will have to give up our nomadic lifestyles. By encouraging aggressive demographic policies and especially developing our great cities, we can increase our population enough to prevent Russian incursions on our territory.

Xacitarxan has been one of the key political and comercial centres of the Pontic steppe since its foundation in 1460. Its age, however, is starting to show. In order to implement a modern transportation network and to eliminate potential sanitary problems, we can invest in a renovation of Xacitarxan to make it the true jewel of the Idel.

The Steppes have seen the fall of many nomad empires: the Saka, the Xiongnu, the Mongols... All have faded and are now only remembered in history. But the Steppes need a leader to unite them into a single state, not a Khanate a relic of the past, and who will protect them from Imperialism, be it from Europe or Asia!
